name: prompt-manager-decision-workflow-polish
title: Prompt-Manager Decision Workflow Polish
description: Close the decision-workflow gaps surfaced across two consecutive morning vision walks (2026-04-23, 2026-04-24). The decision CLI/API/UI surface works for straightforward accept/reject on decisions with explicit options, but falls short on several common operator flows: deferring a decision for a revisit window (forces semantically-wrong rejection today), partially accepting an option while scoping out parts of its rationale (forces burying modifications in --notes prose), and consuming decisions with no A/B/C options (forces awkward --selected=__other__ --freeform="accept as proposed" pattern). Also: display gaps where options aren't shown in CLI human output and heartbeat-list conflates three distinct lifecycle states (scheduled-but-never-fired vs dormant vs broken). None of these are individually blocking but together they're dragging the vision walk by ~10+ minutes per session and creating ambiguity about whether the tool supports what the operator wants to do. All work must ship across API + CLI + UI per the operator's three-surface parity rule.
